## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

   **Bugs and stability.**

      Review window: Jul 16, 2026 - Jul 28, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _its_fine_, Jul 28, 2026, 1/5: "It’s very buggy. Options trading rarely works."
            2. _Dog Runner 99_, Jul 27, 2026, 1/5: "This is the worst banking app out there. Its user interface is glitchy and doesn’t fit on the screen. You can’t do many things in the app that you are forced to do via a browser or have to go to a desktop to complete. You have to swipe left and right to pull the data left and right to read it since it doesn’t fit. Its login system sometimes uses Face ID and sometimes reverts to a password prompt. It randomly logs me out. It doesn’t have a daily balance history. Nothing is easy, intuitive or useful about this app. It sucks."
            3. _Zac Chevalier_, Jul 16, 2026, 1/5: "Literally every time I sign in, I need to send a verification code. Why include a "remember this device" option if it never works? Infuriating. edit: still an issue half a year later. They also added a new page that comes up at app launch that needlessly requires an extra click before I can begin the log in process. They've managed to make it worse. edit2: another half year and it continues to get worse. No fix for the previous complaints and the app frequently freezes now. Force shutdown ftw"
